desc: **Task 1+2 (Brute force & derivation check):** Memoized exhaustive solver on (V, p) states as ground truth; closed form verified for N≤5 with A_i≤5 and random N=6 cases, plus all-even/all-odd/all-ones probes; confirmed only parities of A_i and p matter.
**Task 3 (Final implementation):** O(N) solution reading via `sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()`, counting odd A_i, printing per the N=1 / N=2 / N=3 / N≥4 case rules.
**Task 4 (Edge cases & performance):** N=1, N=2, N=3 (all-even vs some-odd, incl. (1,1,2)), and N=2·10⁵ with A_i≤1e9 handled in O(N); samples give Fennec / Snuke / Snuke.
**Task 5 (Review & finalize):** Brute-force vs closed-form head-to-head agreement confirmed; test harness gated behind `--test` so judging path is pure O(N) I/O; code finalized.
